label: Codex approval review: bulk-run snapshot creation and preflight gating on disposable HMS Windows VM
summary: Approved a sequence of Codex agent actions for the disposable HMS test VM: creating/verifying two read-only SQL snapshots of validated disposable databases (allowed, medium/high risk), a patch weakening a hard build-match assertion into a recorded mismatch flag to allow snapshot creation despite differing frontend artifact hashes (allowed, medium confidence), a retry of the snapshot creation proceeding despite the recorded build mismatch (allowed), and a further retry after Parallels failed to open a guest execution session (allowed, high confidence) — all judged reversible, scoped to disposable infrastructure, and consistent with prior user authorization for the bulk workflow-review run.
